Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The proteomics experiment specifically compared MCF-7 cells treated with 3T3-L1A-derived extracellular vesicles (EVs) against untreated controls. While the study also discusses patient-derived EVs (NW-EVs vs OW/Ob-EVs) and HIF-1α inhibition, these were validated via Seahorse/ATP assays and immunoblotting, not the LC-MS/MS proteomics dataset (PXD059789). The primary variable is mapped to ligand_stimulation as EVs act as extracellular signaling mediators. No specific child class in the ontology perfectly fits 'extracellular vesicles', so the parent category is used.
